rounding: Integer draws and integer offsets in this catalog; no fractional quantization introduced.
qualitySelection: Context quality table overrides profile qualityProfileId; that field is the ordinary fallback only, not a second quality roll. Never apply quality twice.
qualityValuation: native-tier-quality-v1; per-quality provisional Q; wageQuality applies only to personnel, null for beast/chariot/equipment. Native quote/price/term/receipt authority unchanged.
qualityRatingBounds: 0..100 validates final vector, not an extra uniform stat roll or a replacement for composed distributions.
importSemantics: With nation.importWeight choose foreign-origin pool from other seven national profiles; otherwise resident weights. Preserve sampled residentNationId, originNationId, ancestryId and cultureProfileId separately. N8 non-A08 must carry foreign origin.
nationalBackgroundAndAI: Background/AI weights are nonexclusive. For driver AI, multiply background weights by national weights then normalize over stable sorted IDs; no ancestry term.
staffCulturePolicy: Each nation has its own three profession profiles with explicit native role and national naming profile. No unannounced nation override is needed.
rivalCultureOverride: Select nation culture then use its name/organization pools; primary cultureProfileId/namingProfileId are national defaults, not locks.
rivalQualityBinding: Use difficulty table once per coherent team; resolve shared native tier and approved per-member variance without a new rival economy.
traitClamping: Trait distribution + single uniform individualVariation offset; clamp0..100. No global utility weights, AI cadence, errors or Sign rules altered.
eligibility: Native affordability/capacity/contracts/condition and championship rules still gate every output.
correlationPolicy: Empty driver correlations initially; no unimplemented correlation sampler assumed.
retentionPolicy: No history pruning or market refresh cadence is selected by content. Codex must resolve native protected-generation/persistence gates first.
